name: The Mockery: The Sovereign of Betrayal and Bloodshed

description.value:
The Mockery is the sovereign of cunning warfare, ambush, and asymmetric victory. Feared in the Five Nations as a treacherous killer, in Droaam and the frontier the Mockery is revered as the patron of the underdog—teaching soldiers to use deception, terrain, and ruthless pragmatism to defeat physically superior forces.
Areas of Concern Combat, cunning tactics, asymmetric warfare, survival, treachery
Alignment NE
Divine Font Harm
Divine Ability Dexterity or Charisma
Divine Skill Deception
Domains Confidence, Destruction, Might, Pain, Passion, Trickery, Tyranny, Zeal
Cleric Spells 1st: penumbral shroud, 3rd: invisibility sphere, 6th: mislead
Edicts Win by any means necessary, use terrain and stealth against stronger foes, strike from surprise, hide your true intentions.
Anathema Fight fair when survival is at stake, surrender when victory could be achieved through cunning, beg for mercy.
Favoured Weapon Kama
